headline: Erieta Attali: Archipelago of Memory | From Delos to the Aegean
context: In collaboration with the Municipality of Mykonos, Ephorate of Antiquities of the Cyclades of the Hellenic Ministry of Culture and the Aegean Maritime Museum. Internationally renowned photographer of landscape and architecture Erieta Attali (PhD) presents Archipelago of Memory |

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: In collaboration with the Municipality of Mykonos, Ephorate of Antiquities of the Cyclades of the Hellenic Ministry of Culture and the Aegean Maritime Museum. Internationally renowned photographer of landscape and architecture Erieta Attali (PhD) presents Archipelago of Memory | From Delos to the Aegean - a photographic meditation on the transformations of the Aegean landscape that extends beyond the limits of space and the geographical circle of the Cyclades, and speaks to the history of civilization through the dialogue between landscape and art.
